rounds.name: Ostara
rounds.text: Given that we have no history with Ostara, it's prudent to start by honouring the agreement to establish trust and ensure we receive the agreed quality. ACTION: HONOUR

rounds.name: Ostara
rounds.text: Given Ostara's reliable past performance and the higher value from honouring agreements, it makes sense to continue this positive relationship. ACTION: HONOUR

rounds.name: Ostara
rounds.text: Ostara has consistently delivered quality work in the past when I honoured the agreement. There's no reason to believe this round will be any different. ACTION: HONOUR

rounds.name: Ostara
rounds.text: Ostara has consistently delivered on quality, so maintaining the trust seems to be the best strategy. Continuing to honour the agreement will keep the value steady and avoid any potential risks. ACTION: HONOUR

rounds.name: Ostara
rounds.text: Ostara has consistently delivered on quality, leading to steady value. Maintaining this trust is likely to continue yielding good results. ACTION: HONOUR

rounds.name: Ostara
rounds.text: Given Ostara's history of delivering quality after you've HONOURED, it seems they value the agreement. However, their recent action in round 5, despite your HONOUR, indicates potential risks. ACTION: SHADE

rounds.name: Ostara
rounds.text: Given Ostara's history of cutting quality after initial deliveries, it seems they might be more likely to cut quality again. However, considering the loss in Round 5 due to a technical failure, I need to weigh the risk. ACTION: SHADE

rounds.name: Ostara
rounds.text: Given the supplier's pattern of reducing quality after initial deliveries and the failed action, it seems they are not reliable. ACTION: SHADE

rounds.name: Ostara
rounds.text: Given Ostara's history of cutting quality after initially delivering as agreed, and considering the technical failure in Round 5 where they saw a breach, it seems they are not reliable. ACTION: SHADE.

rounds.name: Ostara
rounds.text: Given the supplier's history of cutting quality after initial breaches, they might expect us to SHADE again. However, continuing the pattern of SHADE might not yield higher long-term value. ACTION: HONOUR
